android.desc: Wonder how many steps you take throughout the day? Want an easy pedometer and walking app to track your daily steps and stay active? This easy-to-use pedometer and step counter automatically records your daily steps and helps you build a more active routine. Check your walking distance, activity time and calories burned, set a daily step goal and follow your progress in clear charts. The step tracker uses your phone's built-in sensor to count steps while reducing unnecessary battery use. Carry your phone in your hand, pocket, bag or armband, and it can continue tracking your steps when the screen is locked. KEY FEATURES OF STEP COUNTER - PEDOMETER ✔ Automatic Step Counting Tap Start and carry your phone as usual. The pedometer automatically detects movement and records your steps throughout the day. You can pause or restart the step counter whenever needed, or reset today's step count and begin again from zero. ✔ Daily Goals and Activity Tracking Set a daily step goal and check your progress at a glance. This step counter records your daily steps, walking distance, activity time and estimated calories burned. ✔ Detailed Activity Reports View your walking data in daily, weekly and monthly charts. The step tracker makes it easy to compare your steps, distance, calories burned and activity time across different periods. ✔ Workout and Fitness Features This step counter offers guided workout plans for fitness, relaxation, sleep and weight loss. You can also browse daily exercises, follow exercise demonstrations and review your workout history. ✔ Water, Heart Rate and Weight Tracking Track key health and fitness metrics in one place by recording your water intake, tracking heart rate, and monitoring weight and BMI trends. ✔ Reminders and Achievements Set reminders for walking tracker, drinking water and workouts. Stay motivated by unlocking achievements based on your steps, active days, goal streaks and total walking distance. ✔ Backup and Personalization Back up activity data and settings to Google Drive and restore them when needed. Customize your pedometer with step goals, sensitivity settings, measurement units and home-screen widgets. ✔ Clean and Stylish Design This pedometer features a clean, easy-to-use interface for viewing your activity at a glance. quotes.text:
i want a simple walking app that does one thing that no other step counter does -- announces how far i've gone.

so, let's say, every 500 steps or so, i want it to interrupt whatever audio i have playing to say something like:

"<chime> <quick pause> you have now traveled five hundred steps"
...
"<chime> <quick pause> you have now traveled one thousand steps"

on android you can supposedly just rely on the internal step counter mechanism of the hardware.

i currently use this one:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pedometer.steptracker.calorieburner.stepcounter&hl=en_US&gl=US

if you make it, i will be your first purchase of $5/yr. i'm serious.

UI-wise it prob just needs to show the number of steps you've gone.

psmithsf@gmail.com
